arguments.message: Hi there! Meridian’s SSO works with any identity provider that speaks SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect – that includes the major SSO services most teams use. A workspace can only have one provider configured at a time, so you’ll need to pick the provider you want to keep and migrate the other team’s accounts to it. If you need help planning the migration order for the specific pair of providers you’re using, just let us know and we can advise.
